name: Tail Swipe
card_text: Target 1 Level 5 or higher Dinosaur monster you control; if that Dinosaur monster is still face-up on the field, choose up to 2 monsters your opponent controls that have a lower Level than it, or are face-down, and return the chosen monsters to the hand.
available_set: LEGENDARY COLLECTION 4 JOEY'S WORLD MEGA PACK
SPEED DUEL: TRIALS OF THE KINGDOM
